profiles.pilot_scope: Replay a synthetic ledger with distinct Personal Credit, Community Credit, Bonus, contribution recognition, spending/deletion and capacity constraints. Compare allocation rules against held-fixed physical inputs.
acceptance_metrics: Issuance/deletion and contribution-recognition totals reconcile exactly under the declared profile.
Allocation policy changes distributional outcomes only; physical capacity and aggregate feasible delivery remain invariant.
Unknown capacity or contribution evidence produces an explicit indeterminate disposition.
negative_controls: Attempt to transfer, lend, collateralize or invest Personal Credit under a profile that forbids it.
Infer producer financial payment from buyer credit deletion.
Issue contribution credit from settlement alone, without qualifying evidence.
Authorize community allocation beyond the declared physical capacity.
deployment_assumptions: Synthetic data only for initial benchmark.
No live account, issuance, or payment effects.
profiles.off_ramp: Export a canonical event/assessment manifest and disable the adapter without changing the underlying Mycelix Finance record history.
nonclaims: Does not endorse Creditism or establish economic superiority.
Does not imply AYU Points are money or that a live Creditist economy is operating.
Does not establish housing availability or physical capacity.

negative_controls: Mutate a source digest, status, or revision.
Remove a previously observed source or add a duplicate source identifier.
Present a website observation as an exact versioned schema.
deployment_assumptions: Read-only source snapshots; no claim to decide Integral's own source authority.
No external effects are executed.
profiles.off_ramp: Keep the source manifest and lifecycle receipt portable as JSON; stop consuming the adapter without deleting its historical receipts.
nonclaims: Does not claim Integral endorsement or approval.
Does not establish that an external specification is ratified unless its source explicitly establishes that status.
Does not authorize an operational action.
